        None \<Rightarrow> t'' |
        Some dest_p \<Rightarrow> t'' (dest_p := list_replace (t'' dest_p) src dest)) |
      Some src_p \<Rightarrow> (case n dest of
        None \<Rightarrow> t'' (src_p := list_replace (t'' src_p) dest src) |
